title: Administrative district boundaries
publisher: Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM), via data.gov.my
description: The 160 administrative districts of the 13 states and 3 federal territories as drawn on data.gov.my.
used_for: State and district of every hex

title: Population Table: Administrative Districts
description: Mid-year population by district: the adjusted 2020 Census count, then intercensal estimates (cohort-component method). Districts created since 2025 are folded back into the districts they were carved from.
used_for: Population and growth of Malaysia, its states, federal territories, districts and cities

title: MyCensus 2020 area profiles (Kawasanku): religion by district
description: Shares of all residents of each district, citizens and non-citizens, by religion as recorded by the 2020 Population and Housing Census, from the data behind DOSM's Kawasanku dashboard. Its 'atheist' group is DOSM's 'Tiada agama / Tidak diketahui' (no religion or unknown).

title: Real GDP by district and by state; real GDP of Malaysia
description: Annual GDP at constant 2015 prices for five sectors (agriculture, mining, manufacturing, construction, services) and import duties: by district to 2020, by state and for Malaysia to 2025. The state table has offshore oil and gas as its own row.
used_for: Gold (GDP) of districts, cities, states and Malaysia

title: Employed persons by industry and state, 1982-2021
license: Creative Commons Attribution (archive.data.gov.my; version not stated)
description: Labour Force Survey estimates of employed persons by MSIC 2008 industry for each state, in thousands; the estimates from 2020 are benchmarked to the 2020 Census. The archive portal is the only place DOSM publishes this by state.
used_for: Food, Production, Science and Culture yields (workers by industry)

title: Labour Force Survey: district and state
description: Annual labour force and unemployed persons (thousands) by district, to 2024, and by state, to 2025. States and Malaysia use the state table's 2025; districts and cities use 2024, where the four areas that are one district (Perlis, Kuala Lumpur, Labuan and Putrajaya) take their state's row.
vintage: States and Malaysia 2025 annual; districts and cities 2024 annual

title: Household Income and Expenditure Survey: district, state and Malaysia
description: Mean and median gross monthly household income (RM), mean monthly household expenditure, the Gini coefficient and the absolute poverty rate (share of households below the poverty line income) by district and state, and the national median.
used_for: Income, poverty, Gini and household spending

title: Labour force by educational attainment and state, 1982-2021
license: Creative Commons Attribution (archive.data.gov.my; version not stated)
description: Labour force (aged 15 and over, thousands) by highest education reached (no formal education, primary, secondary, tertiary) for each state and for Malaysia. The only education table DOSM publishes by state; none exists by district, so every district gets its state's mix.
used_for: Education row of the City View (a state mix)

title: ETOPO1 Global Relief Model
publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (via ERDDAP)
description: Elevations and depths from ETOPO1 at every arc-minute.

title: Sentinel-2 10m Land Use/Land Cover
description: The annual 10 m land-cover map, exported as one ~550 m image and grouped into the renderer's terrain classes. Oil palm and rubber estates are classed as trees by this map; oil palm is moved to cropland (see the oil palm map).

title: Natural Earth v5.1.2
description: Neighbouring countries, lakes, rivers and settlement locations.

title: Global Power Plant Database
description: Malaysian generating stations of 25 MW or more as WRI listed them (v1.3.0, which records no capacity year for them; solar from Wiki-Solar). Plants built or closed since are not reflected, and some large Sarawak hydro stations are missing.
vintage: Database v1.3.0; WRI records no capacity year for Malaysian plants

title: Wikidata: oil fields, gas fields and LNG terminals in Malaysia
description: Items with coordinates whose class is an oil field, gas field or LNG terminal and whose country is Malaysia.

title: Crops by district
publisher: DOSM, with the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security (MAFS) and the Department of Agriculture (DOA), via data.gov.my
description: Planted area (ha) of fruit, vegetable, spice, herb, cash and industrial crops by district (annual, 2017–2024). It has no oil palm, rubber or paddy.

title: Global industrial and smallholder oil palm map, 2019
description: A 10 m map of industrial and smallholder oil palm made from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery. It replaces 'trees' with 'cropland' under oil palm in the land-cover samples and gives each district's oil palm area. Rubber and other tree crops are not in it.
used_for: Plantations counted as cropland, not forest

title: Permanent reserved forest by state
publisher: DOSM, from the Forestry Department (Perhutanan), via data.gov.my
description: Area (ha) of gazetted permanent reserved forest by state, annual.

title: Natural Earth v5.1.2 roads and railroads
description: Roads and railroads at 1:10m as map art, read from the shapefiles of the pinned release.
used_for: Roads and rail on the map

title: OurAirports
description: Airport reference points; passenger figures are not in it.

title: Wikidata: annual passengers of Malaysian airports
description: Total annual passengers (arrivals plus departures) of airports whose country is Malaysia, with the year, as Wikidata records them (originally from Malaysia Airports and the Department of Civil Aviation).

title: Lecturers in public universities
publisher: Ministry of Higher Education (MOHE), via data.gov.my
description: Lecturers by public university, citizenship and sex, annual: the measure the research-university wonders are ranked by.

title: UNESCO World Heritage List: Malaysia
description: Malaysia's six inscribed properties (Gunung Mulu, Kinabalu, Melaka and George Town, Lenggong Valley, Niah Caves, FRIM Selangor Forest Park). Positions are hand-checked points from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata; there is no download.

title: Impact of Floods
description: Value of flood losses (RM thousand) to living quarters, vehicles, business premises, manufacturing, agriculture and infrastructure, by state and district, from DOSM's yearly Impact of Floods workbooks. Each year is taken from the latest release that carries it.
used_for: Flood losses by state and district
